{{Quote|Terrific! A hat with its own ''weather''!|[[Marn Hierogryph]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 29">[[Knights of the Old Republic 29|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 29]]</ref>}}
The '''Helm of Dathka Graush''' was a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], presumably created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]]. It amplified the wearer's abilities to wield [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and possibly strengthened the [[Sword of Ieldis]]. It also caused [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] disturbances within a radius of six kilometers.

In [[3963 BBY]] it was contained in the [[Jedi Covenant]]'s secret [[Sanctum of the Exalted|storehouse]] on the planet [[Odryn]]. There it was undergoing inspection and extensive research at the orders of [[Haazen]] and [[Krynda Draay]].

Like all the artifacts stored on Odryn, the ill effects of its [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] contamination could be safely contained as long as the helm was encased in [[nullification resin]]. Grade three resin was required to protect the surrounding environment from the relic's power. When the helmet was removed from its resin case for analysis, the resulting weather disruptions caused apprehension among the superstitious [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] warriors guarding the compound.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Exodus3.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The helm of Dathka Graush?]]
In [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]], a flashback showing the [[Discovery of Korriban|arrival]] of the [[Exiles]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] shows a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] being worshipped by members of his species while wearing a helmet that resembles the Helm of Dathka Graush.<ref name="GoldenAge2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> [[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]] identified the [[Sith King]] when the Exiles arrived on Korriban as [[Hakagram Graush]],<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> presumably [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka]]'s descendant.<ref name="endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 1)}}</ref> This could mean that the Sith shown in ''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2 is Hakagram Graush and that he was wearing the Helm of Dathka Graush after it was passed down from Dathka Graush.
